payload.purpose: Compress a source-supported benefit, proof, and payoff into a decisive conversion arc.
payload.targetViewerState: Convinced by specific evidence and ready to take the source-supported next action.

grammar.hook: Lead with the strongest source-supported benefit or costly problem.
grammar.escalation: Alternate claim, friction, and evidence at explicit editorial beats.
grammar.proof: Show quantified proof only when its exact value exists in source evidence.
grammar.reveal: Use one deliberate pattern interrupt to expose the mechanism or offer.
grammar.payoff: Resolve into a concrete outcome with hierarchy concentrated on the benefit.
grammar.cta: Render one governed CTA after proof, never before credibility is established.

pacing.protectedPausePolicy: Protect comprehension pauses after quantified proof and immediately before the offer.

caption.typographyGrammar: Short stacked cards; numbers receive emphasis only when directly sourced.

bRoll.policy: Use proof-bearing product or process visuals; decorative stock is forbidden.

audio.musicBehavior: Licensed rhythmic bed may rise across escalation but must duck under every spoken claim.
audio.sfxBehavior: Short render-safe accents only on hook, verified proof, reveal, and CTA.

brandConstraints: CTA and benefit colors must come from the approved brand/default kit.
Never imitate a reference creator's identity markers.
accessibilityConstraints: No flash sequence exceeds accessibility limits.

failureClasses.label: Unsupported claim
failureClasses.description: A benefit, number, or outcome is not present in source evidence.

failureClasses.label: CTA before proof
failureClasses.description: The call to action arrives before credibility is established.

failureClasses.label: Pattern-interrupt spam
failureClasses.description: Interrupts occur without semantic editorial beats.

failureClasses.label: Conversion hierarchy blur
failureClasses.description: Benefit, proof, and CTA compete at the same visual level.

failureClasses.label: Cheap urgency
failureClasses.description: Canned urgency devices undermine premium credibility.

renderFallbacks: Replace unavailable proof visuals with source-timestamped typography.
Reduce motion before reducing evidence dwell time.
provenanceRules: Quantified claims require an exact transcript or supplied-evidence pointer.
Music and SFX must be licensed and render-safe.
